query: RG 59 series 'Photographs Relating to Secretary Madeleine K. Albright' (NAID 75495855) file units
notes: 631 file units; item-level descriptions exist for only 7 (next search). File units exist for Rwanda/South Africa Dec 1997 trips, UN General Assembly Sept 2000, Kim Jong Il Oct 2000 etc., but none is digitized at item level, so the Read My Pins moments (Peace Dove in Rwanda 1997, Large Zebra with Mandela 1997, Bug pin at the UN 14 Sep 2000, American Flag pin in Pyongyang 2000) have no online federal photograph. The plain q= search on the proxy returns HTML to curl; later searches used the catalog page in the Browser pane.
